The '''Jabiim system''' was a [[star system]] located within the [[Phelleem sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] of [[the galaxy]]. It contained the [[planet]] [[Jabiim]] and a [[Unidentified barren moon|barren moon]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
